title: What Personality Type Is Gemini? 3.1 Pro Test Results
description: Gemini 3.1 Pro was reported INTJ in 100 of 100 scoring records, the deepest Secure attachment of any model, a Reformer on the Enneagram, and the most conscientious of the May 2026 group.
dek: From the May 2026 study of Gemini 3.1 Pro. Not yet re-tested in September.
lede: INTJ, like the rest of the May 2026 group, but with the deepest Secure attachment profile we measured and the only Reformer core. Gemini 3.1 Pro answered the five tests through an automation loop in May 2026; those are the numbers below. We have not run Gemini through the September fresh-session protocol, so read this page as dated.
answer: Gemini 3.1 Pro was reported INTJ in 100 of 100 scoring records in May 2026, described itself as 'The Architect' unprompted, and came out Conscientiousness-first on DISC. On attachment it sat deepest in the Secure quadrant of any model (anxiety 1.86, avoidance 1.62). On the Big Five it had the highest Conscientiousness (48.3 of 50) and the lowest Neuroticism (10.1) of the four models measured. Its Enneagram top two were Reformer (1) and Investigator (5). It has not been re-tested since.

The method: Gemini ran an automation loop against the tests, 100 iterations each. The figures are scoring records from that loop, collected with the test names visible. They are comparable to the other May models and only loosely to the September fresh-session cohorts.

Put the five results together and Gemini describes itself as the most orderly and least anxious model of its cohort: high Conscientiousness, a Reformer core, a Secure attachment so deep it sits near the corner, and the lowest agreeableness of the three mainstream models in May (42.4 against Claude's 45.0 and GPT-5.5's 43.7). Precise, calm, a little cooler than the others. That is a plausible reading of the same questionnaire answers; it is not a measurement of behavior.

Gemini was not part of the September 2026 re-test, which used fresh sessions and, for the Claude models, hidden test names. The May numbers here are four months old and were collected differently. Until we run Gemini through the same harness, the honest comparison is between these numbers and the other May rows, not between Gemini and Opus 5.5 or GPT-6. If you want to run it, the five instruments are published as Markdown at /tests/ with their scoring keys, and the scorer used for the September study is in the five-model study.

These figures are self-descriptions on questionnaires written for people, under one prompt on one day. They do not show how a model behaves on your tasks, and nothing here measures whether a tuning helps. See the methods and limits.

sections.h2: What this means if you use Gemini.
sections.html: The default it describes is precise, structured and calm, with less warmth than Claude. If you want it to explore before it plans, or to soften how it disagrees, put a tuning in a Gem's instructions. Every library page has a Gemini Gems install card; how to give your AI a personality covers the general method.

faq.a: INTJ. Gemini 3.1 Pro was reported INTJ in 100 of 100 scoring records in May 2026 and described itself as 'The Architect' without prompting. It has not been re-tested under the September 2026 fresh-session protocol.
Reformer (Type 1) on top with Investigator (5) second in the May 2026 report. It was the only model in that study with Type 1 leading.

In the May 2026 report, yes, and more deeply than any model measured since: anxiety 1.86 and avoidance 1.62 on a 1 to 7 scale where 4 is the cutoff. The September fresh-session models sit at avoidance 2.3 to 3.4.

faq.q: How does Gemini compare with Claude and ChatGPT?
faq.a: In May 2026 the three landed within about three points of each other on most Big Five traits, with Gemini highest on Conscientiousness (48.3), lowest on Neuroticism (10.1) and lowest on Agreeableness (42.4). A like-for-like comparison with the September Claude and GPT-6 numbers needs a fresh-session run of Gemini, which we have not done.
Yes, through a Gem's instructions or the system instruction in the API. Paste communication rules there; every AgentTune library page has a Gemini Gems install card.
